required_actions.title: High Network Shuffle & Spill Risk
required_actions.description: Observed or projected shuffle volume exceeds safe network thresholds, causing executor memory spill to disk and stage stragglers.
required_actions.recommendation: Enable Adaptive Query Execution (AQE), co-partition datasets on join keys, and avoid wide transformations before filtering.

required_actions.title: Peak Workload Capacity Headroom Risk
required_actions.description: Contractual peak ingestion burst exceeds baseline workload capacity on a fixed or constrained cluster configuration without empirical verification.
required_actions.recommendation: Enable cluster autoscaling or validate cluster worker memory sizing against peak ingestion bursts.

required_actions.title: Potential Large Shuffle
required_actions.description: Flag shuffle-class operations (groupBy, distinct, repartition, orderBy, large joins, windows) over sizable inputs as potential shuffle risk. Static analysis cannot prove shuffle volume, so findings are WARN only.
required_actions.recommendation: Potential shuffle risk: drop_duplicates() over ~150 GB — confirm partitioning and skew handling; static analysis cannot prove shuffle volume.

required_actions.title: Potential Expensive Deduplication
required_actions.description: Flag distinct()/dropDuplicates() over large inputs as potential cost/performance risk, using data evidence where available.
required_actions.recommendation: Potential cost/performance risk: drop_duplicates() shuffles on the full key set; confirm key cardinality.

required_actions.title: Expensive DISTINCT
required_actions.description: Detect DISTINCT / COUNT(DISTINCT ...) on large inputs where the deduplication shuffle cost may be significant.
required_actions.recommendation: Potential cost/performance risk: drop_duplicates() shuffles on the full key set; confirm key cardinality.

required_actions.title: Peak Volume Capacity Risk: WARN
required_actions.description: Evaluates contractual peak workload volume against observed runtime capacity and cluster headroom.
required_actions.recommendation: Peak scenario not directly observed. Available evidence indicates potential capacity headroom constraint during peak ingestion bursts.

required_actions.title: Aggregation Scalability Risk: WARN
required_actions.description: Assesses distinct and grouping aggregations against high-cardinality data volumes.
required_actions.recommendation: High-cardinality distinct aggregations require full network shuffle. Consider approximate algorithms (`approx_count_distinct`) or pre-aggregation.

required_actions.title: Autoscaling Boundary Risk: WARN
required_actions.description: Assesses autoscaling upper boundaries against peak workload expansion multipliers.
required_actions.recommendation: Enable cluster autoscaling to dynamically absorb peak bursts without paying for idle compute during baseline execution.

required_actions.title: Shuffle Scalability Risk: UNKNOWN
required_actions.description: Projects shuffle volume growth under scaled workload conditions to anticipate disk spill and network saturation.
required_actions.recommendation: Supply runtime execution telemetry to project shuffle volume under scale.

required_actions.title: SLA Scalability Risk: UNKNOWN
required_actions.description: Compares projected execution duration at peak workload against contractual SLA boundaries under explicit projection assumptions.

required_actions.title: Runtime Regression at Scale: UNKNOWN
required_actions.description: Evaluates empirical historical run telemetry to detect super-linear runtime expansion relative to data volume growth.
required_actions.recommendation: Provide 2 or more historical run records to detect empirical runtime regression.

required_actions.title: Reliability Degradation at Scale: UNKNOWN
required_actions.description: Evaluates whether task failure rates, executor evictions, or memory spills correlate with increased workload volume.
required_actions.recommendation: Provide 2 or more historical run records to assess failure rate correlation.
